info.title: Maplenou Customer Service API
info.description: Ticket management for customers, sellers and delivery drivers, handled by support agents. Errors follow RFC 9457 (application/problem+json) with a stable 'code' and, when relevant, the business 'rule' (BR-xxx).

put.summary: Assign: empty body or agentId=null assigns to the caller; another agent requires a manager
Language of the notifications the caller receives (fr or en)
Replace statuses and transitions (administrators); the lifecycle rules are checked
Change the targets of one priority: first response in minutes, resolution in minutes or days
Replace the priorities (administrators); new priorities get default SLA targets
Replace the permission matrix (administrators); safety rules are checked

get.summary: List / search / filter tickets (requesters only get their own)

post.summary: Requester: rate the answer of a resolved or closed ticket, once (1 to 5)

get.summary: Conversation. Support may pass visibility=PUBLIC|INTERNAL; requesters only get PUBLIC

post.summary: Apply (true) or dismiss (false) the category/priority suggested by the assistant
A reply draft from the help centre; the agent edits it before sending
Release the delivery of the ticket so that a courier can take it again
Ask Maplenou to open a return/refund request for the order of the ticket
Send a message to the courier of the delivery, in the Maplenou app

get.summary: Statuses (with kind and FR/EN labels), manual transitions and priorities
Support only: requester, order, payment, delivery, seller and refund context of a ticket
CSV export of the tickets matching the filters (managers and administrators)
